skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Diversity Oneness
skins.content: Test Collection Series/Diversity Oneness. A possibility derived from when Virtuosa connected to the Law: emotions link together the hearts of all. The performer who once plucked at their heartstrings is now no more than a voice in the chorus.
skins.quote: She sees a Laterano: open, harmonized, mutualistic. Amidst the unending flow of emotion, people no longer close off their hearts. Mutual achievement, mutual comfort. Each their own self, her included.
